item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】FLAC - Blake Shelton + Gwen Stefani + Mickey Guyton @ Crypto.com Arena 2022-02-11 (audience recording)
item.description:
This was a fun weekend. Even though I don't even listen to most of the bands. Got in for like $14 I think. Staples is a terrible place to see a show but a fun place to wander around and smoke weed and watch whoever if you are in for a nominal expense.
